# Product/brand names, acronyms, PSP/provider names, currency & country
# adjectives, and code identifiers that show up throughout docs/ and
# shouldn't be flagged as spelling mistakes. One term or regex per line,
# case-sensitive unless noted otherwise. See https://vale.sh/docs/topics/vocab
#
# The bulk of this list was seeded by running `vale docs` against the
# existing (reviewed) docs and accepting everything that wasn't an actual
# typo. Add to it as new terms come up in review — no need to touch the
# workflow or .vale.ini for that.
